title: Sorting Hat Quiz
description: Discover which Hogwarts house you belong to.
longDescription: The legendary Sorting Hat looks deep into your personality and determines your true Hogwarts house.

resultsInfo.moreInfo: You were sorted into Gryffindor because you’re brave, bold, and willing to stand up for what matters—you lead with your heart, even when it’s not the easiest path.
You were sorted into Slytherin because you’re driven, focused, and not afraid to chase what you want—you think ahead and play the long game, and that’s a powerful strength.
You were sorted into Ravenclaw because you’re thoughtful, curious, and always looking to understand more—you see the world a little differently, and that’s something worth holding onto.
You were sorted into Hufflepuff because you’re genuine, loyal, and grounded—you show up for people and stay true to yourself, and that kind of consistency really matters.

questions.text: You discover a hidden door in Hogwarts.

answers.text: Think how it could benefit you.

questions.text: A student is being treated unfairly.

answers.text: Take charge and fix what you can.

answers.text: Turn opinion back in your favor.

questions.text: What would you miss most if you left Hogwarts?

answers.text: The thrill of adventure on the grounds.
The warmth of your common room.

title: Wand Quiz
description: Find out which wand chooses you.
longDescription: Wands choose the wizard. Answer honestly to discover your magical wand core and style.

resultsInfo.moreInfo: You were matched with a Phoenix Feather core because you’re resilient, rare, and capable of rising through anything—there’s a spark in you that refuses to burn out.
You were matched with a Dragon Heartstring core because you’re powerful, bold, and full of intensity—you don’t hold back, and your strength speaks for itself.
You were matched with a Unicorn Hair core because you’re steady, kind, and deeply grounded—your strength comes from consistency and a quiet sense of purpose.
You were matched with a Thestral Hair core because you see what others don’t—you carry depth, understanding, and a quiet strength shaped by experience.

title: Patronus Quiz
longDescription: Your Patronus represents your inner strength and happiest memories.

resultsInfo.moreInfo: Your Patronus takes the form of a stag—proud, protective, and steady when those you love need you most.
Your Patronus is a wolf—loyal, fierce, and happiest when your pack is close at hand.
Your Patronus is an otter—playful, warm, and fueled by joy and the people who make you laugh.
Your Patronus is an eagle—sharp-eyed, free, and always rising above what holds others down.
Your Patronus is a horse—enduring, spirited, and always pushing forward toward the light.

title: Character Quiz
description: Which character are you most like?
longDescription: Your personality may match one of the famous witches or wizards of Hogwarts.

resultsInfo.moreInfo: You match Harry Potter—brave under pressure, loyal to your friends, and willing to do what is right even when it costs you.
You match Hermione Granger—curious, prepared, and the person everyone trusts to figure things out.
You match Ron Weasley—loyal, funny, and more courageous than you sometimes give yourself credit for.
You match Draco Malfoy—ambitious, sharp, and careful about the image you project to the world.
You match Luna Lovegood—gentle, original, and unafraid to see what others refuse to notice.

Potterhead tier—outstanding! You know the books and films inside out. Ten points to your house.
